purpose: One fixed ridge recipe learned on four inspected 2024 windows and evaluated once on four predeclared later 2025 windows; isolated research
quality: Approved, unqualified, finite; exact station/series/statistic 00011/units, preserve signed instantaneous flow; no interpolation or window substitution

model.name: oxygen-clock-temperature:ridge-100
model.objective: sum squared residual error plus alpha times sum squared standardized coefficients; intercept unpenalized
model.preprocessing: center and scale from 2024 training rows only
model.selection: one recipe fixed before training and before test capture; no candidate search, refit or tuning on the test
model.note: With sum-loss and fixed alpha the relative penalty also depends on training size; this evaluates the whole new fit, not a causal effect of seasonal diversity

evaluation.primaryBaseline: persistence: future oxygen equals current oxygen
evaluation.primaryMetric: MAE in mg/L, same accepted origin/target pairs for all methods
evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean of four seasonal MAEs; relative gain is 100 times (1 - macro model MAE / macro persistence MAE); zero baseline yields null relative gain
evaluation.availabilityMeaning: Practical research completeness screen, not a scientific power or accuracy guarantee

uncertainty.method: paired calendar-block bootstrap within each season; resample nonempty blocks and recompute equally weighted seasonal mean error differences
uncertainty.seedRule: baseSeed plus blockHours, Python Random MT19937
uncertainty.limitations: Exploratory uncertainty conditional on these selected windows and assumed block dependence; not a distribution-free or ecological guarantee

decision.credibleExploratoryImprovement: All four test data screens pass; macro MAE decreases; no seasonal point MAE increases beyond numerical tolerance; primary and sensitivity bootstrap lower bounds of macro paired absolute-error gain exceed numerical tolerance; no negative predictions
decision.seasonalMeaning: No observed seasonal point-MAE loss does not prove statistical noninferiority in every season

freezeOrder: Commit protocol before fit; commit frozen model and implementation before acquiring test values; captures bind protocol and exact frozen model raw-body hash
predictionIntervals: Not calibrated in this point-forecast test; do not reuse the failed summer band
scope: Retrospective finalized archive for one station and one-hour dissolved oxygen; no live-availability, pollutant/causal intervention, ecological benefit or three-month skill claim
mission: Preserve environmental coordination, verifiable evidence, community/youth decision rights and funding tied to verified outcomes; LLM, Oracle operational routing, governance and contracts unchanged
